audit.concept_type: booking: room picker with dates handing off to their direct-book engine, plus whitetip dive package enquiry and getting-here guide
must_keep: direct-book.com booking engine as the primary action
two room types with guest counts
oceanic whitetip shark dive package enquiry (email template)
restaurant hours and WhatsApp dinner booking
flight, taxi and car rental guide
weaknesses: identical room descriptions and swapped room photos between home and rooms page
dead buttons (View room, Discover activities, Book your activities, Lunch, Dinner)
'paradise' and 'private escape' headline, Port Howe never named
whitetip season buried on a sub-page
star-graphic review cards including an unnamed 'Guest Review'
audit.note: New 2026 WordPress site with a real booking engine; decent but generic, weak on rooms, activities and SEO.
